bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website (SevenRooms) or by phone. Reservations are encouraged but not required.
groups: Six private rooms named after plants seat from 8 to 30; the largest, the Garden Suite, has its own entrance and a lounge. Larger banquet menus are set for 8 to 10 guests, some ordered one to three days ahead.
dressCode: Men in long trousers and closed shoes; women in a dress, or a blouse with trousers or a skirt, and dressy shoes. No shorts or slippers.
